notes.title: Fixed dead-end loops, increased hero skills and removed stamstamine bonus
notes.notes:
By the player report lack of solution field means, add 3 hero skills, start the round to get randomly.

Skill 1: Gold-5, Man-5 - Destroy all enemy minions

Skill 2: man-1 deals 5 damage to enemy heroes

Skill 3: Gin-1 kills minions at random

* Artefact card disappearance bug has not been tested, if encountered, please describe in detail in the comment area.

You are welcome to leave a comment to provide valuable opinions
